I think the author works a little too hard to be fair to the G1 but it's a decent review.

column21: When you do what you really love, you don't count the money.  Your pay-off is from the sense of accomplishment.  Doing something for love and wishing that the money follows really depends on who else gains value from what you do.  E.g. living in a log cabin in Alaska - minimal payback.  Creating, building and selling iPods - huge payback.  The difference being not many people are chuffed at you living in a log cabin.  Lot of people are very chuffed at having the music they love when they want it and having a cool gadget to play it on.
